as_told.title: The Moon rang like a bell in the Apollo seismic tests

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that during the Apollo missions to the Moon in 1969, when Apollo 10 left the Moon, the Moon "rang like a bell," and NASA, the US space agency, was baffled. A researcher, Randall Carlson, says NASA collected three or four years of data from instruments on the Moon showing it kept vibrating for a long time. A philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says the test was then repeated on purpose, he thinks on Apollo 13, and Michels later says seismometers (quake-measuring instruments) were set up and a rocket stage was crashed into the Moon deliberately, crediting a scientist named Gordon MacDonald. Those who tell it take it as a sign the Moon may be hollow, or even something built, as one episode puts it, an alien spaceship.
